model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," has a logarithmic scale and ranges from approximately 1 to 10^4, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale and ranges from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features six lines, each representing a method: Base (black, solid, circles), MEND (brown, dashed, diamonds), FT (blue, solid, triangles down), MEMIT (purple, solid, circles), IKE (red, solid, triangles up), and ROME (green, solid, squares). Starting from the left, the Base line begins around 39 and increases to approximately 44; the MEND line starts around 43 and increases to approximately 54; the FT line begins around 42 and increases to approximately 48; the MEMIT line starts around 43 and increases to approximately 53; the IKE line begins around 43 and increases to approximately 50; and the ROME line starts around 55 and increases to approximately 65.
